protocol.percentile_definition: ascending midrank of mean raw predicted saliency_map per stage4 grid cell within its own frame; ties preserved
protocol.prototype_selection: highest mean anchor-to-member visual similarity among top-8 activated prototype groups
protocol.ranking: select prototype by maximum mean visual similarity; return its complete connected group in graph activation-rank order
protocol.anchor_self_membership: included in group mean; omitted from matches to avoid duplicate input
protocol.small_group_policy: skip anchors below minimum retrieved matches
protocol.context_target: original patch inside red box; surrounding pixels provide context only
